This timeline is a research aid for the [History](history/index.qmd) chapters. It places events and claims in chronological order while keeping uncertainty visible.

Dates are **working dates** unless a linked source record shows otherwise. Approximate or contested dates are labelled. The 1993 and 1994 CSIL entries are both retained because later sources disagree about the program's starting year; the 1995 entry preserves both later official “province-wide” wording and contemporary “new/pilot” wording.

The **Confidence / status** column indicates how strongly the available public evidence supports each entry. Follow the associated source links before treating a date or description as settled.

On small screens, the timeline table scrolls horizontally within its own region. Keyboard users can tab to that region and scroll it independently.
